name: Uchisaiwaicho
tagline: Otemachi in 4 minutes and Tokyo in 9 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥170,000 to ¥180,000.
summary: The station is in Chiyoda City, served by Toei Mita Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 4 minutes to Otemachi, 25 minutes to Shinjuku, 26 minutes to Shibuya and 19 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥170,000 to ¥180,000. The station stands 2.9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 3.2 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 2.9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 2.2 m to 5.4 m, a difference of 3.2 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 7 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 3 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 25 clinics and 20 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 浩邦会日比谷病院, about 2 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 十仁病院, about 7 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Toei Mita Line.
congestion: Toei Mita Line runs at 146% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 西巣鴨→巣鴨, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥170,000 to ¥180,000, 1K ¥150,000 to ¥160,000, 1LDK ¥310,000 to ¥320,000 and 2LDK ¥460,000 to ¥470,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥170,000 to ¥180,000. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Shimbashi, but Uchisaiwaicho is ahead on the number of medical facilities.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It takes 5 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Uchisaiwaicho. One-room rents run about ¥18,000 lower.

neighbours.lead: Kasumigaseki is ahead on the number of lines and how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Uchisaiwaicho is ahead on how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Uchisaiwaicho.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
People who want another route when service is suspended
People who want to finish their shopping on foot
People who want to hold the rent down
noiseSources: 日比谷通り (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 2 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 9 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The number of points that fall inside the projected inundation area is about average for a station in the 23 wards.
leads.stationNote: Only the Toei Mita Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
